svg.aria-label: The EU AI Act sorts systems into four tiers: prohibited practices such as exploiting vulnerabilities, high-risk systems such as credit scoring and hiring, systems with transparency duties such as chatbots, and minimal-risk systems. Prohibitions apply since 2 February 2025, transparency duties from 2 August 2026, and Annex III high-risk duties from 2 December 2027 after the Digital Omnibus. It applies to Indian firms when their outputs affect people in the EU.
svg.text: Banned since 2 Feb 2025 · transparency from 2 Aug 2026
High-risk (Annex III) from 2 Dec 2027 after the Omnibus

g.text: applies to Indian firms when outputs affect EU residents
